title: A Uniform for the Letter
author: Y. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Ivo Okafor, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, has spent seven years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
